units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">Esth. R. to I, 14</cite> (play on <cite ref="U02138"><he>שתר</he></cite> <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">ib.</cite>, v. <cite ref="U02078"><he>שָׁתָה</he></cite>) <he>משקה … כוס של ת׳</he> I will make them drink the cup of staggering.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:4">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>עתיד … כוס תַּרְעֵילָה וכ׳</he> in the future the Lord will make the nations (that oppress Israel) drink the cup of staggering out of the place whence judgment goes forth (Eden).
